newsitem.title: USA: Baxter unit loses breast implant case.
newsitem.headline: Baxter unit loses breast implant case.

text.p: Baxter Healtcare Corp, a unit of Baxter International Inc, said late Thursday after the market closed that a Middlesex County jury has returned a verdict of $1.1 million in damages to a woman in a lawsuit involving silicone breast implants.
Baxter said that proceedings in the lawsuit, Vassallo v. Baxter Healthcare Corp are continuing, with a hearing scheduled before Middlesex Superior Court Judge Margot Botsford on December 3.

Baxter, which never manufactured or marketed breast implants, merged more than a decade ago with American Hospital Supply Corp, which had owned Heyer-Schulte Corp, a breast implant manufacturer, before divesting in 1984.
